تفتتحين (form VIII)
# تَفْتَتِحِينَ (taftatiḥīna) /taf.ta.ti.ħiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# تُفْتَتَحِينَ (tuftataḥīna) /tuf.ta.ta.ħiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
